title: Aligning MLLMs with the Latent Structure of Human Cognition via Behavior-Derived Semantic Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2610.41951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations and decision criteria align with the latent structure of human cognition. In this work, we propose a novel framework to align MLLMs with the multidimensional mental representations underlying human similarity judgements. We build on a previously established behavior-derived semantic embedding space, in which objects are represented along 66 interpretable dimensions derived from 4.70 million human Odd-One-Out (O1O) judgements. For each triplet, we infer the most salient decision dimension and convert it into a dimension-grounded linguistic rationale. translated_title: 通过行为导出的语义维度将多模态大语言模型与人类认知的潜在结构对齐
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在广泛的推理任务中取得了令人瞩目的表现，但其内部表示和决策标准是否与人类认知的潜在结构相一致仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将MLLMs与人类相似性判断背后的多维心理表征对齐。我们基于先前建立的行为导出语义嵌入空间，其中物体沿着66个可解释的维度进行表示，这些维度源自470万次人类“找出不同项”判断。对于每个三元组，我们推断出最显著的决策维度，并将其转换为基于该维度的语言理据。这使得MLLMs能够学习最终选择，同时学习与推断出的行为标准相一致的解释。实验结果表明，我们的方法提高了模型与人类相似性判断的一致性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种新框架，利用源自470万次人类“找出不同项”判断的66个可解释语义维度及其对应的语言理据，将多模态大语言模型的决策标准与人类认知的潜在结构对齐，从而提升模型与人类相似性判断的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework that aligns MLLMs' decision criteria with the latent structure of human cognition by deriving 66 interpretable semantic dimensions from 4.7 million human Odd-One-Out judgements and converting them into linguistic rationales, thereby improving model consistency with human similarity judgements.
